des: Create .mcp_server_settings.json under data directory. You can choose from the following MCP services or add new MCP services.
Continuously testing and adding useful MCP services. Contributions are welcome.
Remember to delete comment lines. The des attribute is for explanation only and will not be parsed.
The des and link attributes are only for explaining installation methods to check original links; they are not mandatory.
Currently supports three transport modes: stdio (standard I/O), sse (Server-Sent Events), streamable-http (streaming HTTP).

streamable-http-mcp-server.des: Use Streamable HTTP transport mode, suitable for production web deployments
